ablation: plain positive residual trend with no cohort divergence term
allocation: fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: Frontier-A through Frontier-J development evidence is already observed. Frontier-K is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. The 2023-2024 fold is already SPENT from preregistered topology-migration forward validation and is excluded from K selection and mutation.
cost_hypothesis: weekly rebalance, sparse top-five books, cash on absent state, and persistent eligibility exits should limit unnecessary turnover; fixed cost ladder evaluated without post-result retuning
failure_mode: divergence is noise, a low-correlation proxy, or an allocator-erased rescaling of momentum
falsifier: prefer cohort-conforming positive-trend leaders instead of divergent leaders
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
rebalance: Mondays; persistent immediate strict-liquidity loss exits
selection: positive scores, top-K, deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Activates the unmeasured Frontier-I reserve before any Frontier-K return look. Cohort membership is defined causally from trailing residual trend ranks; no symbol identities are fixed.
stop_rule: freeze if matched ablation or destructive falsifier matches/beats canonical parent, or if every valid base cell is below fixed 1.0 development floor; do not invert or retune after observing failure
thesis: Positive residual-trend leaders whose recent residual path diverges from the contemporaneous high-trend cohort represent more idiosyncratic and potentially less crowded momentum.
timing: completed daily bars only; trailing windows and fixed historical lags; no 2023+ selection
universe: historical is_liquid == 1 for signal graph/cohort and weights; no hand-picked symbols
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT and diagnostic-only for Frontier-K; 2025+ diagnostic/live evidence never drives mutation
